name: ttrpg-codex
description: Self-hostable web codex for D&D and other TTRPGs

scripts.lint:app: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives --tsconfig frontend/tsconfig.json --ignore-pattern "**/*.mts" frontend/src frontend/test frontend/vite.config.ts contracts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:app && npm run lint:tools
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:app -- --fix && npm run lint:tools -- --fix
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:source && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && go run ./tools/check.go fast
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run test:tools && npm --workspace @ttrpg-codex/frontend test && npm --workspace @ttrpg-codex/frontend run test:browser && go run ./tools/check.go test
